The '''Galactic [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] Mechanics Union''' was an organization active during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with which the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] engineer and criminal [[Onicrop K'Cin]] was associated.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Galactic Podracing Mechanics Union was fist mentioned in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' released by [[LucasArts]] in [[2002]]. The union was mentioned in the e-scanner bounty entry for Onicrop K'cin, a secondary bounty available during the second level of the first chapter.
